name: Dumbbells
notes: Workhorse of the library - presses, curls, rows, lunges, calf raises.

name: Weight Plates
notes: Loaded onto the barbell, the plate-loaded machines and held for weighted hyperextensions.

name: Landmine
notes: Barbell sleeve pivot. Used for landmine rows.

name: Adjustable Bench
notes: Flat and incline. Covers dumbbell bench, incline press and incline fly.

name: Cable Crossover Machine
notes: Dual adjustable pulleys - crossovers, face pulls, lateral raises, pressdowns, Pallof press.

name: Lat Pulldown Machine
notes: Pulldowns and straight-arm pulldowns.

name: Cable Attachments
notes: Rope, straight bar, V-bar, wide lat bar and single D-handles.

name: Leg Press Machine
notes: Bilateral and single-leg pressing.

name: Iso-Lateral Chest Press
notes: Plate-loaded, independent arms.

name: Iso-Lateral Row
notes: Plate-loaded, independent arms.

name: Chest Fly Machine
notes: Pec deck.

name: Shoulder Press Machine
notes: Plate-loaded.

name: Back Extension Machine
notes: Seated, selectorized. Distinct from the 45-degree bench.

name: 45-Degree Hyperextension Bench
notes: Weighted hyperextensions, plate held to the chest.

name: Pull Up Bar
notes: Pull ups, scapular pull ups, dead hangs, hanging leg raises and front lever work.

name: Body Weight
notes: Not a thing you own - the entry floor work maps to, so no exercise is left without an equipment label.

name: Parallel Bars
notes: Dip station - chest dips and parallel bar leg raises.

name: Exercise Mat
notes: Planks, hollow rocks, V ups, push ups.

name: Dip Belt
notes: Adds load to pull ups and dips.

name: Plyo Box
notes: Step ups, step downs and the rear foot on Bulgarian split squats.
